description: Source code for ApplicationX11 class managing X11 window events, input, and rendering for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment within the Starboard platform.

classes.name: ApplicationX11
classes.description: Manages X11 window events, input handling, and rendering for a Raspberry Pi 4 within the Starboard platform.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates a new X11 window with specified options.

methods.name: DestroyWindow
methods.description: Destroys the specified window and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Composite
methods.description: Performs compositing of video frames onto the window.

methods.name: AcceptFrame
methods.description: Accepts a video frame for rendering.

methods.name: SwapBuffersBegin
methods.description: Prepares for buffer swapping, locking the frame mutex.

methods.name: SwapBuffersEnd
methods.description: Completes buffer swapping and updates video bounds.

methods.name: PlayerSetBounds
methods.description: Sets the bounds for a video player.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application, setting environment variables.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and stops the X11 display connection.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Checks if system events are available.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for system events with a timeout.

methods.name: EnsureX
methods.description: Ensures the X11 display connection is initialized.

methods.name: StopX
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the X11 display connection.

methods.name: GetPendingEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next pending X11 event.

methods.name: XEventToEvent
methods.description: Converts an X11 event to a Starboard application event.

methods.name: FindWindow
methods.description: Finds the internal window object corresponding to an X11 Window.
